I replied to Pree in a thread on their correction in #central-team. The reply confirms the new inbound lane at Marrow Agrisupply is at Gate 47, not Dock 23. I also asked anyone who saw the earlier message to use Gate 47.

There was no saved memory to fix, because I never stored the Dock 23 value. The correction is now in the channel alongside the original message.
